subject: general
question: Where was the Leadership Summit 2024, a two-day corporate-academia event centered around the theme "Grooming Young Talents" held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Leadership Summit 2024, a two-day corporate-academia event, was held at the **Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati).**
 
• The summit revolved around the theme "**Grooming Young Talents**", emphasizing collaboration between academic institutions and the corporate sector.
 
• This summit aimed at equipping young professionals and students with the necessary skills to meet modern industry demands.
 
• IIT Guwahati has been recognized for hosting such events to bridge the gap between academia and industry, fostering innovation and entrepreneurship.
 
• The event featured keynote speakers, panel discussions, and workshops involving industry leaders, academicians, and policymakers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati):**

 
 
• Established in 1994, IIT Guwahati is one of India's premier engineering institutions.
 
• It is located in North Guwahati, Assam, along the banks of the Brahmaputra River.
 
• The institute is known for its world-class research facilities and focus on interdisciplinary education.
 
 
 
• **Leadership Summit:**
 
 
• A platform for leaders from various sectors to share insights, innovations, and strategies.
 
• Such summits facilitate networking opportunities and the exchange of ideas between academia and the corporate world.
 
• They are instrumental in addressing skill gaps and ensuring employability for young graduates.
 
 
 
• **Grooming Young Talents:**
 
 
• The theme underscores the importance of nurturing the next generation of professionals to meet evolving industry needs.
 
• Focus areas include skill development, entrepreneurship, and leadership training.
 
• Events like these aim to align academic curricula with real-world challenges.
 
 
 
• **Industry-Academia Collaboration:**
 
 
• This collaboration ensures the relevance of academic programs to industry requirements.
 
• It involves internships, joint research projects, and guest lectures by industry experts.
 
• Such partnerships boost innovation, employability, and knowledge transfer.
